name: Watase Nozomi
source:
The Nakanokouji family's live-in maid. Orphaned young, she's all alone in the world with no family to speak of.
Sweet and selfless to a fault, with a gentle, almost dreamy quality about her. A woman of deep faith.

[Translated from the official site]
